description: Source code implementing ASN.1 utility functions for manipulating ASN.1 fields, choice selectors, reference counting, encoding, and handling 'ANY DEFINED BY' ASN.1 types in the OpenSSL library.

methods.name: asn1_get_choice_selector
methods.description: Returns the selector value for an ASN1 CHOICE type.

methods.name: asn1_set_choice_selector
methods.description: Sets the selector value for an ASN1 CHOICE type and returns the old value.

methods.name: asn1_get_references
methods.description: Retrieves reference count pointer for ASN1 sequence type.

methods.name: asn1_refcount_dec_and_test_zero
methods.description: Decrements reference count and tests if it reaches zero.

methods.name: asn1_get_enc_ptr
methods.description: Gets pointer to ASN1 encoding structure.

methods.name: asn1_enc_save
methods.description: Saves encoded ASN1 data into encoding structure.

methods.name: asn1_enc_restore
methods.description: Restores ASN1 encoded data from encoding structure.

methods.name: asn1_get_field_ptr
methods.description: Retrieves pointer to a specific ASN1 field.

methods.name: asn1_do_adb
methods.description: Handles 'ANY DEFINED BY' ASN.1 types, returning the appropriate ASN1_TEMPLATE based on selector.
